answer: The mechanism is a paid identity anchor: each agent posts collateral a contract locks before it can earn or vote, and payouts split across identities sharing one attestor graph. A Sybil attack becomes a bulk purchase: to win a tenth of the vote an attacker funds that many independent bonds, keeps each funded through an audit window, and burns fees proving work per clone. Cost scales linearly while marginal influence stays capped, so a thousand keys costs no less than acting honestly. Attackers watch that collateral slashed into a river of forfeited stake, and the ivory ledger blocks replay.
